note: EXAMPLE master-bedroom-suite spec, mm, y-up, origin SW corner. Anonymized 2026-07-03: derived from a real project's dimensioned plan; all client/firm/project identifiers and source references stripped. Room 5500x6500, ceiling 2800. Windows omitted (unknown), door+ensuite placement are draft design judgment. REVISED 2026-07-02 (Gate 0 v0.4 findings, all in the draft-judgment zone): ensuite interior 3100->2900 so the AS-BUILT east leg proves 2500 (walls extrude outward 100 per build_room; kh.55 kh.20); ensuite door moved to its south wall, out-swing (east-face door was unreachable past the bed block); headboard depth 600->574 to clear the ensuite's as-built south wall band; wardrobe 3200->2100 opening a 1000 mm walkway; entry door shifted 100 west (panel pinched entry to ~800); vanity stool moved into the ensuite as a fixture (its old coords sat on the shower); end-of-bed bench REMOVED - no position satisfies the 610 ergonomic pinch in this layout. REVISED 2026-07-03 (FUNCTION gate, placement_logic): the fused headboard_tv is split into a plain 'headboard' partition (same footprint, TV semantics removed) + a standalone 'tv_panel' on the SOUTH wall at the bed FOOT, rot 180 so it faces the bed - the fused TV had no controllable position and the render put the screen behind the sleeper's head (GS-24). The panel sits x2750-4150, WEST of the entry-door swing (door x4400-5300) and east of the wardrobe (x<=2100); ~2.1 m from the bed centre (within the SMPTE/THX band). REVISED 2026-07-03 (FUNCTION WARN): the 100 mm built-in beside the bed was mis-typed 'wardrobe' - it is far too shallow to hang clothes (needs 450-650) and cannot be deepened without hitting the bed (east edge x5198); the room's clothes storage is the two 600 mm wardrobes. Re-typed wardrobe->cabinet (a shallow display cabinet, its true function), so furniture_dimensions no longer mis-checks it against the hanging-depth norm; it also renders as a wood built-in.
